speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe the appearance of the rash on your scalp and forehead, and when did it first start?

speaker: Patient
text: 3-month-old boy. The parents report that the rash has been present for several weeks, noting that it sometimes appears red and scaly, especially during cold weather. The patient was born at 36 weeks' gestation and has been generally healthy since. The patient's father has a history of psoriasis.

speaker: Doctor
text: Are there any specific areas on the scalp where the rash is thicker or more scaly, such as behind the ears or on the eyelids? Also, do you have a history of eczema, or does your baby seem itchy?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Rash on scalp and forehead. I also have Erythematous patches, Greasy yellow scales, Worse in cold weather.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Serum 25-hydroxy vitamin D level; REQUEST IMAGES: Please provide close-up photos of the scalp showing the distribution of the greasy yellow scales.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Infantile Seborrheic Dermatitis (Cradle Cap)
